subject: LaunchHub accelerator — credit routing & sandbox consolidation request
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily@launchhub.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: LaunchHub accelerator — combining sandbox credits with demo credits?

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looked great. Quick ask from our ops team: we run a two-phase accelerator (sandbox + demo week) and were hoping to combine the free sandbox credits you offered with the demo-day promo credits so teams can use one pool across both phases.

Current constraints from our side: billing needs a single usage bucket to simplify reporting for sponsors, and we prefer the conversion path to Reserved/Dedicated to be an opt-in after demo week.

Can Redwood route credits so they act as a single pool that can convert to Dedicated seats within 90 days, and can we get a one-time top-up clause if a team goes over by >25%? Would love to understand any product or billing limitations here.

Attached: our standard sponsor T&Cs (ops asked me to share).

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Program Lead, LaunchHub
ops@launchhub.co

---Attachment: launchhub-sponsor-terms.pdf (document stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@launchhub.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchHub accelerator — combining sandbox credits with demo credits?

Emily — really appreciate the clear ask and context. Short answer: yes, we can offer a routed credit pool that behaves as a single sandbox+demo bucket, but there are a couple of operational knobs to confirm (billing classification, sponsor invoicing, and the conversion workflow to Dedicated). Looping in Marissa (CS / program packaging) and Laura (finance) to confirm the billing top-up and reserved conversion constraints.

Marissa / Laura — details below from LaunchHub: they want (1) a single usage pool across phases, (2) optional conversion to Dedicated within 90 days, and (3) a one-time top-up trigger for overages >25%. Also attached a doc from Emily with sponsor T&Cs. Can you advise on whether we should:
- implement a single credit SKU for the program (preferred for ops)
- allow a one-click conversion in the Console for teams to move to Dedicated and consume remaining credits against commit
- offer a single invoice to LaunchHub with a capped uplift clause (e.g., top-up capped at X) or bill on actuals

I'll propose a short playbook once I have your read.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

---Attachment: (from Emily) launchhub-sponsor-terms.pdf referenced

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily@launchhub.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchHub accelerator — combining sandbox credits with demo credits?

Hi all — quick ops/packaging take. We can create a single program SKU ("LaunchHub Accelerator — Program Credit") that maps to one usage pool. Operational notes:

- Billing: We can produce a consolidated monthly invoice to LaunchHub for charges against the program SKU. For the one-time top-up, finance prefers a pre-agreed cap or a staged approval flow rather than open-ended actuals.
- Overages: propose a clause — first 25% overage covered by the program (no charge), above 25% triggers a one-time top-up invoice at negotiated discounted rate.
- Conversion: Console will support redemption to Dedicated seats, but conversion to Reserved capacity requires a signed amendment (automated UI opt-in + legal doc). Remaining credits can be applied to commit as an offset for the first billing period post-conversion.

Action items I suggest:
1) Laura — can you confirm a recommended cap threshold and billing cadence we should propose to LaunchHub?
2) Sergio — can you share the sponsor T&C you attached to Emily so legal can pre-check the amendment flow?
3) Emily — would LaunchHub accept a capped top-up (we suggest 2x the standard promo rate) and a 90-day conversion window with an amendment for Reserved conversions?

Happy to jump on a short call today to finalize wording.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Packaging, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily@launchhub.co>
Date: 2026-06-04T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchHub accelerator — combining sandbox credits with demo credits?

Thanks — here are the finance constraints and recommended language.

Summary (recommended):
- Consolidated Program SKU billed monthly to LaunchHub.
- 25% overage grace window (no charge). Anything beyond that triggers a one-time top-up invoice at 50% of standard Hosted list price (this gives sponsor a discount but protects Redwood).
- Conversion window: 90 days for teams to convert remaining credits to a Reserved commitment. Conversion requires a signed amendment; credits applied as an offset for the first invoice period post-conversion.
- If conversion is requested for multiple teams under the same program, conversion is executed per-team and will consume the team's remaining credits; LaunchHub will be invoiced for any top-up required at the capped rate.

Legal/billing notes:
- We will generate a single invoice with line items per team (usage rows) to satisfy sponsor reporting.
- Need LaunchHub to sign a program addendum capturing the top-up cap and conversion mechanics. I recommend we include a sample amendment in the term sheet.

I've drafted suggested wording and attached a pricing scenarios spreadsheet showing impact at +0%, +25%, +100% consumption levels. If that's acceptable, Marissa & Sergio, let's propose the capped wording to Emily and attach the term addendum.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

---Attachment: pricing-scenario.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
